description: A dashboard for visualizing ntopng traffic via the ntopng-exporter

panels.description: Requests to ntopng that failed for any reason over the last 5 minutes. Anything above zero is worth a look at the panels below to see which target and reason is responsible.
panels.title: Request Errors (Last 5m)

panels.description: Share of requests to ntopng that failed over the last 5 minutes.
panels.title: Request Error Ratio (Last 5m)

panels.description: 95th percentile of how long ntopng took to answer a request over the last 5 minutes, across all interfaces and targets. If this creeps up toward your configured requestTimeout you'll start seeing timeouts.
panels.title: Request Latency p95 (Last 5m)

panels.description: How many requests per second ntopng-exporter is sending to ntopng. This scales with the number of interfaces multiplied by the number of scrape targets, divided by scrapeInterval.
panels.title: Request Rate

panels.description: Latency percentiles for requests to ntopng, broken down by request type. The hosts target is usually the slowest since it returns every host ntopng knows about on an interface.
panels.title: Request Latency by Target

panels.description: Failed requests to ntopng by request type and reason. timeout means a single request ran past requestTimeout, deadline means the whole scrape cycle ran past scrapeInterval, http_status is a non-200 from ntopng, parse and empty are bad responses, and request is everything else (connection refused, DNS, TLS).
panels.title: Request Errors by Target and Reason

panels.description: p95 request latency for each selected interface, broken down by request type. Use this to find the one interface that's dragging the whole scrape cycle out. The interfacelist request has no interface of its own and isn't shown here.
panels.title: Request Latency p95 by Interface

panels.description: Failed requests to ntopng for each selected interface. Errors for the interfacelist request carry an empty ifname and aren't shown here.
panels.title: Request Errors by Interface

title: ntopng-exporter
